text: The program is notable for being the first to introduce a Contingent Disaster Financing (CDF) option within a policy-based lending framework in Central and West Asia. It aims to strengthen institutional capacity, increase investment in disaster risk reduction, and enhance disaster risk financing through a risk-layered approach. The program supports the issuance of domestic green sukuk and establishes a solidarity fund for risk transfer solutions, such as agriculture insurance.
